author: Zintenka
body:
Wow, this actually took me incredibly fast... like half the day... next thing you know it... ill be making maps in quick succession. Lel. 

Alright, i present to you all... [DTM] War Never Changes (32 vs 32)

On a planet inhabited by two species, there is a dark war that ravages the planet. 50 centuries ago, the war dragged on causing whatever deity that watched over the planet to abandon the sterile land. 

The sky is black of the soot which was caused by the harmful radiation of nuclear warheads.
The water... poisoned by that very same deadly chemical... take heed when you wish to drink... for it may be your last...

The peoples of the planet were-at a time long ago-thriving. But now they must pay the price of genocidal warfare of which they caused.  

War... War Never Changes...

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Well, keep trying bro. At first my maps were a pile of shtako. But as i got the hang of using World Edit and coding YAML for Avicus annd XML for OCN, i got better and quicker at making them.

Here are some really helpful programs:

WorldEdit (Singleplayer) 

VoxelSniper (Never used it because it is for multiplayer servers. Its terraforming is way more sexier than WorldEdit.)

McEdit: You're gonna need this. A lot. It is what i use to copy and paste an island to make a mirrored one. Take heed, this will mess up tilentities and stuff in chests. Do these after you've copied and pasted. I use this to also make the villager trades.

a little note on that... Dispenser cannons are a bit... flawed.
With spreads having destructive power their risk was the danger of being countered and taking time to build. In the new update what happens is that if you blow up the dispenser, it will blow up ALL OF THE TNT that is inside of it. This means that barf cannons, overkills, dispenser spreads are going to be 10x vulnerable than what they originally were.
